project_name: Iglesia OS Ven y Ve - Certificado de Presentación de Niño/a
document_type: Child Dedication / Baby Presentation Certificate (Certificado de Presentación de Niño/a)

physical_format.dimensions: Letter Landscape 11in x 8.5in (1056px x 816px at standard 96DPI display ratio)

primary_navy.usage: Main text titles, heavy structural elements, primary branding borders, QR code fill
primary_navy.apca_contrast: High contrast on white/light backgrounds (14.2:1 contrast ratio)

sky_blue.usage: Primary accent, ribbon borders, icon highlights, subheadings

lime_green.usage: Secondary soft accent, leaf/organic flourishes, seal accents, vitality highlights

typography.script_accent_font: Dancing Script (Script flourish for child name / dedication blessing)

hierarchy.institution_header: Plus Jakarta Sans, 11px, Bold, Tracking 0.25em, Uppercase (#022E5A)
hierarchy.certificate_title: Cormorant Garamond, 34px - 38px, Bold / SemiBold, Tracking tight (#022E5A)
hierarchy.child_name_hero: Cormorant Garamond, 36px - 42px, Bold, Text-Primary (#022E5A) with soft sky-blue underlines or script overlay
hierarchy.statement_text: Plus Jakarta Sans / Spectral, 13px - 14px, Regular, Leading Relaxed (#2C3E50)
hierarchy.facts_labels: Plus Jakarta Sans, 10px, SemiBold, Uppercase, Tracking 0.15em (#4A607A)

svg_artwork_motif.style: Soft organic waves, rounded concentric halos, stylized dove of peace with olive leaf

elements.name: Organic Wave Corners
elements.description: Rounded fluid SVG background waves blending Sky Blue (#0798C8, opacity 0.08) and Lime Green (#61B33B, opacity 0.06) at the top left and bottom right corners, replacing sharp geometric diagonals with gentle curves.

elements.name: Central Halo Emblem
elements.description: A delicate double-ringed SVG halo with soft leaf tendrils framing the church logo or top emblem, using Sky Blue (#0798C8) and Lime Green (#61B33B).

elements.name: Dove & Olive Branch Motif
elements.description: Minimalist, elegant vector outline of a dove carrying a small leaf, symbolizing dedication, blessing, and new life in Christ.

elements.name: Framing Border
elements.description: Dual inner border: Outer 2px soft sky blue (#BCE3F2) line, Inner 1px soft lime green (#CCEBBF) line with 12px rounded corner radiuses (rx=12, ry=12).

elements: Dedication verse text (e.g. Samuel 1:27-28 or Mateo 19:14)
Date of Birth & Place of Birth
Col 2: Fecha y Lugar de Presentación
QR Code for public digital verification

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the certificate strictly maintains the 11in x 8.5in Letter landscape proportions.
Use exact church brand colors (#022E5A, #0798C8, #61B33B) mixed with soft pastel tints for a warm, child-friendly feel.
Use organic, rounded SVG curves and dove/leaf motifs instead of harsh geometric diagonal cuts.

Include data-testid attributes on key certificate fields for automated testing (e.g. data-testid='presentation-cert-child-name', data-testid='presentation-cert-officiant', data-testid='presentation-cert-qr').
Re-use html2canvas + jsPDF export flow matching existing certificate dialogs.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Do not use dark gradients or pure #000000 colors.
Keep typography accessible, elegant, and perfectly aligned.
